title: Black Hole Interiors as a Laboratory for Time-Dependent Classical Double Copy
summary: The classical double copy relates gravity and gauge theory, but its most explicit realizations remain concentrated in stationary or highly symmetric settings. We show that trapped regions of black-hole geometries provide an exact setting for time-dependent classical double copy. More generally, a class of Kantowski--Sachs cosmologies admits an intrinsic double-copy construction: the Kerr--Schild scalar and single-copy field are uniquely reconstructible from the cosmological metric alone, without prior knowledge that the spacetime is a black-hole interior or reference to any exterior…
